propositions: rebar must not use git stash stack operations in the tickets worktree because the stash stack is shared across all linked worktrees of the repository

a stash created in one source worktree can be popped into the tickets worktree, corrupting the store with foreign source files and leaving the index in an unmerged stranded state that blocks all ticket writes

the stash->merge->pop dance in _store/push.py:_resolve_conflicted_pop assumes all stashed modifications live on reconciler-regenerable files, but this assumption does not hold when foreign stashes are applied

the tickets worktree must be mutated only through rebar's supported API and never through ad-hoc git operations, with a durable maintenance entrypoint providing backup-before-first-write and refusal on unpushed commits
unmerged index entries from paths not tracked on the tickets branch and not matching ticket structure must be auto-discarded as foreign pollution rather than wedging every store write
a fsck invariant must report and prevent tracked source paths from being committed to the tickets branch
